name: 32_pierce_instability
title: Pierce diode instability (1D ES, planar) vs the exact dispersion relation

rows.case: Pierce diode alpha = 1.5 pi: growth rate (v0/L) vs exact dispersion root
Pierce diode alpha = 2.5 pi: growth rate (v0/L) vs exact dispersion root
Pierce diode alpha = 2.5 pi: oscillation frequency (v0/L)

notes: Cold beam injected into a grounded gap with an immobile neutralising background, alpha = w_p L / v0. alpha = 1.5 pi: exact w = 0.0000 +0.7657i v0/L, PIC growth 0.7493; alpha = 2.5 pi: exact w = 1.4289 +0.5892i v0/L, PIC growth 0.5572, frequency 1.4130. The determinant root also reproduces the classical stability map (no growing root for alpha < pi, purely growing for pi < alpha < 2 pi, stable again near alpha = 2.9 pi).
